integrity.nature: Exact analytic theorem with a self-contained standard-library rational corroboration script.

scientific_limitations: A deterministic linear one-compartment model with exactly two fixed administrations, a constant positive concentration threshold and an infinite observation horizon.
No bacterial-killing, resistance, toxicity, absorption, multi-compartment, finite-horizon, or clinical effectiveness claim is implied.
Historical priority is provisional within searched and inspected literature; the 1999 periodic nonuniform dosing paper was available in abstract but not full text.
title: A half-life boundary for discontinuous and continuous optimal two-bolus fractionation
